records.subject: Welcome aboard, Bright Systems
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: No customer reply to three Wrenfield emails (email:20eced2e, email:cb949ed6, email:5a48cf66) and no tickets; day 6 of 14 with no project and no milestone. One invite sent shows mild intent, but silent, disengaged Starter accounts rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: One quick step to get Bright Systems started
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Thanks for getting started with Wrenfield — I see an invite has already gone out to a teammate, which is a good sign.

The next step that usually makes everything click is a first project: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and if it's easier, teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that's unclear.

Best,
Chidi
